talk_wizard_1:
Kia ora, tama rangatira!
He aha tāu e mahi nei ki konei?
talk_player_1:
Kia ora!
Ka tukuna ahau ki te whakaora i tētahi tamaiti nā ngā mea e noho ana ki tēnei wāhi.
talk_wizard_2:
Hī...
Kāore ahau i te hiahia ki te whakakore ahakoa, engari ko koe te rima o ngā rangatira ka tukuna ki tēnei mahi. Kāore anō i hoki tetahi, ā kei te hanga o ā rātou tinana i te pātū pēnei i te taonga.
talk_player_2:
Kaua e āmaimai, e tāua. Kāore anō i kitea tetahi pēnei i ahau!
Ka whakamatea e au ngā mea katoa ki konei, ka whakaora hoki i te tamaiti!
talk_wizard_3:
Āe, kāore e kore te āmaimai!
Nā reira kaua e kī ana kāore ahau i whakapūranga!
Ka waiora!
talk_boss_1:
Whakangū! He mea iti tino tino pākari!
Kua tae te wā ki te tīkina tō tīnana! ha ha ha ha
talk_player_3:
Kāore e rerekē te mea whakapōua o tō mea pākari!
Kua mutu ngā rā whakamomore o tō mea!
talk_boss_2:
Tirohia! He rangatira anō e tino āmaimai ana e whakaaro ana ka taea e ia te aukati ahau! ha ha ha ha
Haere mai ki konei!
talk_kid_2:
Kia ora ngā atua!!!
Kua taea e koe te patu i tēnei mea whakamomore! Nui te mihi!
Kāore ahau i te mōhio ki te whakamihi ki a koe!
talk_player_4: He tino manaaki ki te taea te āwhina i a koe! Kaua e āmaimai ki te utu, kua tuku te matua he rau o te rau hei whakaora i a koe! :-)
